messages:
Aisha Nair: Heads-up — 4 preview customers are blocked in the enrollment flow because SSO provisioning plus a new feature-flag gate is preventing workspace creation. One of them (AcmeHealth) is showing early renewal risk in our signals (low usage + onboarding not complete). Can we triage quick? :eyes:

Ben Ortiz: Ugh. Which feature flag specifically? the "greenfield_access" gate?

Aisha Nair: Yes, greenfield_access. It was turned on for the cohort yesterday. SSO shows 'provisioning_pending' on our side for two orgs, and the create-workspace API is returning 409 (flagged).

Carla Matthews: I pushed that flag to a small cohort to test performance. Didn't expect SSO timing to block them. If we need a fast workaround we can temporarily exempt enrolled orgs from the flag while infra/SSO stabilizes.

Sam (SE): I can take AcmeHealth and NovaQ off the critical list and run a 30m walkthrough today. If we do manual invites + session, they can at least kick the tires and we can collect feedback. @Carla — is the exemption safe for a few hours?

Carla Matthews: Yes, we can add a bypass list. Two caveats: need a simple identifier (org slug) and a rollback plan. I'll open a PR to whitelist by org slug for 6 hours.

Ben Ortiz: I'll draft the customer comms (short note + meeting invite). Also adding manual invites to the sandbox: 
```
manual_invite --org acmehealth --role admin --expires 7d
manual_invite --org novaq --role admin --expires 7d
```

devportal-bot: SSO provisioning update: acmehealth.example.com status=PROVISIONING_PENDING (id=org_44321). NovaQ provisioning status=PROVISIONING_PENDING (id=org_44322).

Aisha Nair: Thanks — action items: 1) @Carla add org slugs to bypass list (6h), 2) @Ben send invites + comms, 3) @Sam run enablement sessions today, 4) I will flag AcmeHealth in renewals dashboard and add note.

renewals-signal-bot: Renewal risk marker added: AcmeHealth — reason=low_onboarding_activity + blocked_enrollment; score bump +0.21.

Ben Ortiz: Comms drafted, short + actionable. Meeting links attached, invites sent to AcmeHealth and NovaQ. :thumbsup:

Sam (SE): Done — 30m calls booked for 3pm PT and 4pm PT. Will record notes and micro-survey link at the end.

Carla Matthews: PR merged to add bypass for org_44321, org_44322. Rolling out now. I will monitor telemetry and revert when SSO shows success.

Aisha Nair: Perfect. Once sessions finish, let's capture the micro-survey: 3 quick Qs on setup friction, missing docs, and must-have features. I'll follow up with the renewal team after responses come in.

Ben Ortiz: Copy. We'll attach the micro-survey summary to the customer thread in CRM.

Sam (SE): Quick note after first call: AcmeHealth did a short eval and is relieved. They want clearer SSO guidance in docs (step-by-step with screenshots). Sending notes now. :memo:

Aisha Nair: Great progress — keeping this thread for the short rollback timeline. If anything regresses, ping #eng-oncall. :pray:
